description: This file defines the RecruitmentAttachmentService class, which manages recruitment attachment data and related constants within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It includes a list of allowed attachment MIME types and provides access to a RecruitmentAttachmentDao instance.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentService
classes.description: Service class providing access to recruitment attachment data and constants within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachmentDao
methods.description: Returns the RecruitmentAttachmentDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the service with a new RecruitmentAttachmentDao object.
